title: How Cave Pearls Form
titleZh: 洞穴珍珠是怎麼形成的
subtitle: 托福風格地質學講課：石灰岩洞穴裡的小圓石，如何一層層長成「珍珠」

sentences.en: So last time we looked at how limestone caves form, and today I want to focus on something much smaller inside them.
sentences.zh: 好，上次我們看了石灰岩洞穴是怎麼形成的，今天我想把焦點放在洞穴裡小得多的東西上。

highlights.text: today I want to focus on
highlights.note: 講課開頭點出今天的主題，托福常考「這堂課主要在講什麼」。

examples.en: The temple is built of limestone.
examples.zh: 這座神殿是用石灰岩蓋的。

examples.en: Let's focus on the main idea.

connected.note: looked 的 /t/ 和 at 連在一起。
want to 後接動詞，口語常說成 wanna。

sentences.en: Cave explorers sometimes find little round stones sitting in shallow pools, and they call them cave pearls.
sentences.zh: 洞穴探險者有時會在淺水池裡發現小圓石，他們稱之為洞穴珍珠。

examples.en: Children can swim in the shallow end.
examples.zh: 小孩可以在淺水區游泳。

examples.en: The explorers mapped the river.
examples.zh: 探險者繪製了這條河的地圖。

sentences.en: Now, despite the name, they have nothing to do with oysters, and they aren't valuable in the way real pearls are.
sentences.zh: 不過，雖然叫這個名字，它們跟牡蠣毫無關係，也不像真正的珍珠那樣值錢。

examples.en: Despite the noise, he fell asleep.
examples.zh: 儘管很吵，他還是睡著了。

collocations: have nothing to do with me

examples.en: This problem has nothing to do with you.

grammar.explanation: despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞，不接完整子句。

examples.en: Despite feeling tired, she kept working.
examples.zh: 儘管很累，她還是繼續工作。

grammar.pitfall: 不要說 despite of；也不要寫 despite it is...，要改用 although。

sentences.en: What they share with real pearls is their structure: thin layers built up around a tiny core, like the rings of an onion.
sentences.zh: 它們和真珍珠的共同點在於結構：薄薄的層層包覆在一個微小的核心外面，就像洋蔥一圈一圈的層。

highlights.text: thin layers built up around a tiny core
highlights.note: 定義重點：層狀結構＋中心的核。講者用洋蔥打比方幫助理解。

examples.en: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
examples.zh: 這座橋的結構非常堅固。

examples.en: The Earth has a hot core.
examples.zh: 地球有一個炙熱的核心。

grammar.quote: What they share with real pearls is
grammar.explanation: What 引導的名詞子句當主詞，意思是「它們和珍珠共有的東西」，後面用單數動詞 is。

examples.en: What I need is more time.

grammar.pitfall: 不要把 What 子句當成疑問句，不需要倒裝成 What do they share。

chunks.text: What they share with real pearls
chunks.zh: 它們和真珍珠的共同點

chunks.text: thin layers built up around a tiny core,
chunks.zh: 薄層包覆在微小的核心外，

chunks.text: like the rings of an onion.

sentences.en: So how does that happen underground, where there's no living animal doing the work?
sentences.zh: 那麼，在沒有任何生物負責製造的地底下，這是怎麼發生的呢？

examples.en: Some insects live underground.

grammar.explanation: where 引導關係子句，補充說明 underground 這個地方的情況。

examples.en: We visited a town where nobody owns a car.
examples.zh: 我們去了一個沒有人有車的小鎮。

grammar.pitfall: where 後面要接完整子句，不能直接接名詞。

sentences.en: It starts with water dripping from the ceiling, water that's carrying dissolved calcium carbonate picked up from the rock above.
sentences.zh: 一切從洞頂滴下的水開始，這些水帶著從上方岩石溶出的碳酸鈣。

examples.en: Water was dripping from the roof.
Sugar dissolves quickly in hot tea.
Chalk is mostly calcium carbonate.

chunks.text: It starts with water dripping from the ceiling,
chunks.zh: 一切從洞頂滴下的水開始，

chunks.text: water that's carrying dissolved calcium carbonate
chunks.zh: 這些水帶著溶解的碳酸鈣

chunks.text: picked up from the rock above.

sentences.en: When a drop lands in the pool, it releases carbon dioxide, and some of the mineral comes out of solution and coats whatever lies at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 水滴落進水池時會釋放出二氧化碳，部分礦物就會從溶液中析出，包覆在池底的任何東西上。

highlights.note: 化學用語：溶解的物質重新變成固體析出，是整個過程的關鍵。

examples.en: Plants release oxygen.
Dust coated the old books.

grammar.explanation: whatever 引導名詞子句，意思是「任何…的東西」，在這裡當 coats 的受詞。

examples.en: Take whatever you need.

grammar.pitfall: whatever 本身就包含先行詞，不要再加 anything：anything whatever 是錯的。

chunks.text: When a drop lands in the pool,
and some of the mineral comes out of solution
chunks.zh: 部分礦物從溶液中析出

chunks.text: and coats whatever lies at the bottom.
chunks.zh: 並包覆在池底的任何東西上。

sentences.en: Usually that's a grain of sand or a chip of rock, and it becomes the nucleus of the pearl.
sentences.zh: 通常那是一粒沙或一小片岩屑，它就成了珍珠的核心。

examples.en: There was a grain of sand in my shoe.
A small team formed the nucleus of the company.
examples.zh: 一個小團隊構成了公司的核心。

sentences.en: Here's the crucial part, though: the dripping also keeps the grain moving, rolling it just slightly.
sentences.zh: 不過關鍵在這裡：滴水也讓那粒沙持續移動，讓它微微滾動。

highlights.note: 講者提示重點，後面的內容很可能是考題。

examples.en: Sleep is crucial for memory.

grammar.explanation: keep + 受詞 + V-ing 表示「讓某物持續處於某狀態」。

examples.en: The music kept us dancing all night.
examples.zh: 音樂讓我們跳了一整晚。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 keeps the grain to move。

sentences.en: If the grain stayed still, the mineral would cement it to the floor of the pool, and you'd end up with a flat crust instead of a sphere.
sentences.zh: 如果那粒沙一直不動，礦物就會把它黏死在池底，最後只會得到一片扁平的硬殼，而不是一顆球。

examples.en: Minerals cemented the sand into rock.
We ended up with too much food.
examples.zh: 我們最後食物準備太多了。

grammar.quote: If the grain stayed still, the mineral would cement
grammar.explanation: If + 過去式, would + 原形動詞，表示與事實相反的假設：沙其實會動，所以不會黏住。

examples.en: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
examples.zh: 如果我有車，我就會開車上班。

grammar.pitfall: 主要子句不要用 will；假設語氣要用 would。

chunks.text: the mineral would cement it to the floor of the pool,
chunks.zh: 礦物就會把它黏在池底，

chunks.text: and you'd end up with a flat crust
chunks.zh: 最後只會得到扁平的硬殼

sentences.en: Because it's turned constantly, the coating builds up more or less evenly on every side.
sentences.zh: 因為它不停被翻動，外層就會在每一面大致均勻地累積。

examples.en: Prices are constantly rising.
The work is more or less done.

connected.note: builds 的 /z/ 和 up 連音。

sentences.en: That's why geologists treat cave pearls as a record of conditions in the cave, since they only form where the dripping stays steady for long periods.
sentences.zh: 這就是為什麼地質學家把洞穴珍珠當成洞內環境的紀錄，因為它們只會在滴水長期保持穩定的地方形成。

highlights.text: a record of conditions in the cave
highlights.note: 講者說明這個現象的科學意義，常見於「為什麼重要」的題型。

examples.en: She treats every mistake as a lesson.
examples.zh: 她把每個錯誤都當作一次教訓。

examples.en: Prices have stayed steady this year.

chunks.text: That's why geologists treat cave pearls
chunks.zh: 這就是地質學家把洞穴珍珠

chunks.text: as a record of conditions in the cave,
chunks.zh: 視為洞內環境紀錄的原因，

chunks.text: where the dripping stays steady for long periods.

sentences.en: If a cave is opened to tourists and the drips are disturbed, the pearls can stop growing altogether.
sentences.zh: 如果洞穴開放給觀光客、滴水被干擾，珍珠可能就會完全停止生長。

examples.en: Please don't disturb the birds.
The noise stopped altogether.

grammar.explanation: stop + V-ing 是「停止做某事」；stop + to V 是「停下來去做另一件事」。

examples.en: He stopped talking.

grammar.pitfall: stop to grow 意思會變成「停下來為了生長」，不合理。

sentences.en: Next week, we'll look at how caves are managed to protect features like these.
sentences.zh: 下週，我們會來看洞穴是怎麼管理的，以保護像這樣的地景。

examples.en: The forest is managed by the state.
examples.zh: 這片森林由州政府管理。

examples.en: The lake is the park's main feature.
examples.zh: 這座湖是公園的主要景點。
